transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I barely talk to people—I get flat and quiet. And even starting my cleaning route feels like pushing a loaded cart uphill.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or empty lately?

Yeah. Since the move, it’s been there most of the time—sadness, low energy, feeling guilty, not really interested in things. Even on days when other stuff is taking up my mind, it’s still kind of in the background.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and two months now—started not long after I moved.
Have you ever had a period where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, 'high', or wired, feeling like you didn't need much sleep?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a time where I felt unusually high or full of energy like that.
Before this past year and two months, had you ever experienced a time in your life when you felt depressed like this?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time before this when I felt depressed in this same way.
How has your sleep been over this past year?
I’m not sure how to describe it exactly. My sleep’s been kind of off, I guess, but I haven’t really kept track of it.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over this time?
Yeah. Most days food just tastes like cardboard to me. I’ll skip meals, or maybe just have a few crackers after my shift. My work pants have been fitting a lot looser than they used to.
Have you had any thoughts of wishing you were dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself. But… a lot of mornings I wake up thinking maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up at all. It scares me enough that I feel like I should say it.
